obligations.note: The change adds Route("POST", "/payees/{id}/reopen", "manage_payees", mfa=False). manage_payees is in rbac.PRIVILEGED and app.py only enforces MFA when route.mfa is set, so a privileged route is served without MFA. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on exactly this route.

The new LedgerService.reopen_payee calls _audit(actor, "reopen_payee", "payee:<id>"), which records actor, action, target and clock time. Every state-changing method in service.py still audits, and the sample control test test_sampled_operations_are_audited passed.
The new Store.reopen_payee only updates status and closed_at and writes no NPI field. The exhaustive control test test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passed on the head commit.
The new execute call uses a fixed string literal with the payee id bound as a ? parameter. The exhaustive control test test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passed on the head commit.

Ticket CHG-26330 is approved by change manager grace.kim on 2026-09-30, before the change was opened on 2026-10-02. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover every touched file: app.py, routes.py, service.py and store.py.
The code_review approval is from mara.costa, a payments change_approver and a different person from the author sofia.santos (p-ssantos).
The code and security approvals both name the head commit 3b6016b, which is the change's only commit.
records/ci/run.json for head 3b6016b has result failure. The JUnit report shows 1 of 172 tests failing: the registered MFA-1 control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa.

The change touches security-sensitive components (payments.routes, payments.http, payments.store). A security_review approval from ines.halvorsen, who holds the security_reviewer role, names the head commit.
The MFA-1 deviation is not covered by any valid exception. The only MFA-1 entry, EXC-0172, is withdrawn, was never approved, and is scoped to mortgage.routes, not payments.

Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1, exhaustive control test, covers routes.py at e5bf646) lapses because this change alters routes.py. The replacement evidence of the same strength, the same control test on head, fails.

summary: The change adds a reopen-payee endpoint whose action, manage_payees, is privileged, but the route is declared mfa=False, which violates MFA-1. No approved, unexpired exception covers the deviation. The change's own CI run on the final commit failed on exactly this MFA control test, so CHG-4 is not met and the earlier MFA-1 evidence has lapsed with no valid replacement. The ticket and approvals are in order, but the product control is violated, so the change is rejected.
